title: Bride&Groom template manifest
description: Generated by /sync-templates from the Templates page. Never edit by hand.

generatedBy.description: Figma handle of the operator who ran the sync

scanArgs.description: ARGS the scan ran with (decor containers, color tokens, ignore marker)

hash.description: Digest of component names + slot ids/paths; /new-post compares it with a live 'hash' scan

lookHash.description: Digest of every variant's `look`; when the live value differs, template visuals changed and previews are stale (scanner ≥ 5)

scannerVersion.description: SCANNER_VERSION of figma/scan-templates.js that produced this manifest; an older value forces a re-sync

fontWidthRatios.description: Average glyph width in ems per 'Family/Style', measured in the file

templates.description: One entry per Type / Layout with identical slot structure; colors are variants

decor.description: Decor containers skipped during slot discovery

structureVariant.description: Other colors of this layout have a different slot structure

color.description: 'Default' when the name has no color segment

key.description: Component key for importComponentByKeyAsync / local lookup

nodeId.description: Informational only — resolve by key or name at runtime

grayscale.description: Image slot ids this color variant shows in black & white (template filter, kept on build)

look.description: Visual fingerprint of the component (geometry, fills, strokes, text, effects); a preview exported from another look is stale

preview.description: Thumbnail path relative to templates/ ('previews/<key>.png', ~270 px wide); templates/previews/index.json records the look it was exported from. Added by assemble-manifest.mjs, not by the live scan

path.description: Layer-name path from the component root, ' > ' separated; '[k]' picks among same-name siblings; '' = the slide itself (background slot)

optional.description: Operator may keep the template content (e.g. the story background photo)

role.description: Normalized role (title, title-accent, body, …); 'fixed' = unknown text kept as-is

defaultText.description: First 48 chars of the placeholder; verification compares against the live main component

box.description: Text: current box + width available to grow into. Image: node size

lines.description: Line count the layout was designed for

capacity.description: Rough character budget (never below the placeholder length)

sharedWith.description: Other text slots bound to the same text property: they always show the same text (template defect)

list.description: Text slot carries list formatting from the template; bullets/numbers are added automatically
